title: Enterprise ETL & Analytics Pipeline
scenario: An analytics platform ingests clickstream events from Web App into "1.0 Ingest Events", which writes raw logs to "D1 Raw Events". "2.0 Transform & Aggregate" reads "D1 Raw Events" and enriches them with "D2 Customer Profiles", writes aggregated metrics to "D3 Analytics Mart", and passes summary data to "3.0 Publish Dashboard" for Executive review.
goal: Architect the full three-stage ETL pipeline connecting Web App, three processes, three data stores, and Executive.
learningObjective: Synthesize a multi-stage Level-1 ETL Data Flow Diagram with enrichment joins, warehouse writes, and reporting delivery.
hints: 1.0 Ingest Events connects Web App to D1 Raw Events.
2.0 Transform & Aggregate has two inputs (D1 Raw Events, D2 Customer Profiles) and two outputs (D3 Analytics Mart, 3.0 Publish Dashboard).
3.0 Publish Dashboard delivers the final report to Executive.
solutionExplanation: Web App streams into 1.0 Ingest Events -> D1 Raw Events. 2.0 Transform & Aggregate reads D1 Raw Events and D2 Customer Profiles, writes to D3 Analytics Mart, and feeds 3.0 Publish Dashboard -> Executive.

solutions.description: Three-stage ETL ingestion, enrichment, and executive reporting DFD

edges.description: Ingest writes raw logs to D1 Raw Events
Transform enriches with D2 Customer Profiles
Transform writes metrics to D3 Analytics Mart
Transform passes summary data to Publish Dashboard
Publish Dashboard delivers report to Executive
